title: WinUI 3 override (metadata/overrides/winui/<Class>.yaml)
description: Per-class annotations for the WinUI backend. Members are named by their native winmd names; the generator derives JS names (kebab-case) and checks every name against metadata/winui. Members of a class apply to every element kind whose base chain contains it. Every manual fact carries provenance.

dangerous.description: The `dangerous:` block of an override file: native member name -> annotation, or false to exempt the member from every rule.

severity.description: corrupts-tree: re-parents or removes native children behind the renderer. owned-by-backend: state the backend sets and relies on (a delegate, a target, the application). crashes: can free or double-free a native object the backend still holds. other: anything else (say why in reason).

reason.description: One or two sentences, citing the backend code that owns the state (file:line).

use_instead.description: The svelters way to get the effect (a slot, {#if}, an attribute, an event).

evidence.description: Backend source locations (path:line) that back the reason.

reachable.description: false: JS cannot reach the member today (the backend's tables do not expose it, or a runtime guard refuses it); it is marked so exposure and inference never add it. Default true.

element.description: Present when the class is an element kind (must be constructible per winmd)

tag.description: Defaults to the class name in kebab-case; anything else needs tag_reason

text_prop.description: Native prop that Text children of the element set (`<button>Save</button>` sets Content); the compiler and the renderer fold static and {expr} text into it

as.description: Expose an object-typed prop as a boxed value of this type

test.description: Value the generated test writes and reads back, or a list of values written and read back in order

sync.description: Deliver through host->call_sync while the native handler runs

prop.description: Settable bool on the args set to true when the handler answers true (preventDefault)

close.description: The window close rule of ABI v2: veto (args.Handled) and post while JS listens, else report SVL_GONE_CLOSED

name.description: Argument name in docs and typings

trigger.description: How the generated test raises the event: automation-peer invoke, setting a prop, or `mount` (insert the element into an activated window). An inferred event without one gets a connect test (listen on and off: `verified: connect`)

asynchronous.description: The toolkit raises the event later, not inside the triggering call

prop.description: Native property: a single child (object/UIElement) or a UIElementCollection

attached.description: Attached properties of this class used as per-child attributes of a slot (ABI v2.2 child attrs)

name.description: Attached property name (static Get<Name>/Set<Name> in winmd)

notify.description: Props of this class that get a `notify::<prop>` event: a DependencyProperty change callback (DependencyObject.RegisterPropertyChangedCallback) without payload; the listener reads the prop. The prop must be exposed and a DependencyProperty (winmd), and not on the no_notify list of metadata/rules/winui.yaml.

deny.description: Inferred facts of this class (metadata/inferred/winui) to leave out, as `<section>:<glob>` over the native name (`props:Tag`, `events:Pointer*`) or, for bindings, the binding name. A manual record already replaces the inferred one of the same name.

bindings.description: `bind:<name>` targets in the GTK/Qt binding format (docs/notes/fork-bindings.md section 6), read by tools/metadata/common/gen_bindings.py and tools/metadata/semantics/gen_semantics.py. The name and property are the kebab-case JS prop name; change.signal is the kebab-case event name.
